answer: One concrete mechanism: meter the marginal energy cost of each new identity against the network's median. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the fable to sunk effort, uses the quartz as an corroborating signal, then requires a jade before any payout.
